Thanks again for sponsoring Tribeca this week. Attached are the raw exports you requested: the lead capture CSV (collected at the booth) and the full badge-scan log we ran after the show. I included badge IDs and timestamped scans; where an email was captured on the badge it is populated.

Subject: Re: Tribeca Tech Expo — delivery of lead exports & badge scans

Thanks Jamie — got the files. Team, quick note: marketing attribution in our HubSpot report shows $68k influenced pipeline from Tribeca (UTM_source=tribeca2026), but on the sales side I only see $32k of active deals that were tagged to the event. That gap matters for forecasting and for the partner sponsorship ROI we promised.

Ben, can you run a quick scrub and flag: 1) deals created in the 6/10–6/19 window with any Tribeca or event source; 2) any imported leads that never got a company/owner assignment; 3) email mismatches between badge scans and HubSpot contacts. Attach a sample in your reply.

Marissa, please add a short retro note on what tracking we missed (UTM, QR vs badge capture mismatch) — we should have that for our post-mortem with Finance.

I'd like to close the reconciliation by EOD Tuesday 6/22 so we can finalize the sponsor ROI.

Rachel Kim

rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0184

Quick update — I did an initial pass. Two things I found:

- About 180 leads in the badge export lack an email (badges captured scannable info but not full contact). Many of those appear to have been uploaded as anonymous leads and not merged.
- I pulled a sample: deal #HUB-45237 shows up as created 2026-06-12 with source=Website / UTM missing, but the contact email matches a badge ID in the scans (see attached screenshot).

Attached: hubspot-sample-screenshot.png (shows the contact page + deal). I'll run a merge pass to attach owners and then export the updated deal list. Expect that by Monday morning.

Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jamie Fulton <jamie@eventhub.co>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tribeca Tech Expo — delivery of lead exports & badge scans

Added the retro notes (short) — see attached. High-level items:

1) Tagging gap: several QR codes we used routed to a short URL without UTM params; those leads were captured but not attributed.
2) Import hygiene: two vendors provided lists in slightly different CSV schemas; we need a standard ingest template next time.
3) Owner assignment: booth reps did not consistently assign a HubSpot owner at the time of entry; that created the anonymous leads.

Suggested action items (owners in parens):
- Map badge IDs -> emails where available and merge to contacts (Ben)
- Create a one-page ingest template for vendors (Marissa)
- Update QR landing page to include UTM params and hidden form fields (Growth)

I also added a suggested mileage for sponsor ROI: remove leads without email or company from the influenced figure until merged.

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: tribeca-retro-notes-2026-06-21.pdf)
